title: Neptune Apex Salinity Swing After Top-Off
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neptune:apex probe_name=salinity
streamstats window=6 stdev(value_num) as sal_sd
where sal_sd>1
description: Detects Neptune Apex salinity instability after ATO events.
value: Surfacing neptune apex salinity swing after top-off helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant aquariums, reptiles & vivariums export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It produces when neptune apex salinity swing after top-off matters for your routine.
